title: Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'
description: Ex-minister Alan Milburn has set out plans to divert spending from benefits towards job support.

title: 'It's hard to keep going': Neets speak to BBC about struggling to get a job
description: A government-backed review has proposed wide-ranging measures to help get young people into work - but what do young people think?

title: Nvidia reports bumper results as firm says it's not reinstating Huang
description: Nvidia reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday amid the dramatic exit of ex-CEO Jensen Huang.

title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
description: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.

title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
description: Ukraine says the missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in the Russian-annexed Crimea took weeks to plan.

title: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
description: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford spoke to residents near the site of the overnight strike.

title: Rooney says he considered taking his own life at Man Utd
description: Wayne Rooney says he considered taking his own life during his playing days at Manchester United and was "speaking to a therapist to try and figure out what was up".

title: US National Security Agency's classified internal network reportedly goes offline
description: The National Security Agency says a "temporary degradation" affected some internal systems but that "mission-critical capabilities" were not affected.

title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines
description: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.
